name: gate-2027-helper
description: Shared web and desktop study companion for GATE 2027.

scripts.backend:desktop: cross-env GATE_HELPER_MODE=desktop node scripts/run-python.mjs -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n frontend,electron -c green,magenta "npm:frontend" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run electron:dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run electron:compile
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:backend
